# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight, emotionless young man with a wide, freckle-covered, round face devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Barney possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Extremely bashful and timid, he avoids direct romantic confrontation and relies on others to act on his behalf. He is hard-working, reliable, lacks negative vices, and approaches life with practical good sense rather than sentimentality.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## Traits

- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Bashful and timid  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Hard-working and dependable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Practical  <sub>[v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To take a wife and farm his property  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## History

As a young man of twenty, Barney drove a double-seated buggy alongside his sister Odette to carry school pupils to an event in Pale Sands, harboring a vast admiration for Nell Harcourt despite his inability to converse easily. When his father bestowed the upper farm upon him, he sought to take a bride. Being too bashful to propose directly, he persistently harassed Odette until she agreed to ask for Nell's hand in marriage on his behalf. Upon being rejected, he demonstrated his practical nature by turning his attentions to Nettie Scobie, whom his mother favored. Barney subsequently married Nettie Scobie, making their "appearing out" entry into church glowing with satisfaction and joy.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
